before.styles: Instrumental hardcore punk rock, in E Minor, steady 4/4 with exactly 175 quarter-note beats per minute from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare lock the full-speed running step to that same 175 BPM pulse throughout; snare accents beats 2 and 4 without speeding up. Palm-muted low E guitar drives E5 -> G5 -> D5 -> A5. Its tight three-note riff jumps upward on the last A5 while a second guitar opens into ringing octaves. Root-note bass and dry live kick-cracking snare push against steady eighth-note hats within the 175 BPM grid; the expanded hook doubles the upper guitar rather than relaxing the beat. Aim for about 3:18.
before.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
